# Research handoff — use only the fields needed

An adequate existing report need not be rewritten into this template. Small
fixes need no research packet. For substantial work, normally use a fresh Pro
planning session and then a fresh Codex execution session; an interrupted session
continues the same programme and its existing budget.

## Minimal starts

**Pro:** “Review the selected question on actual available main. Read AGENTS,
`docs/solver/research-standards.md`, `docs/solver/current-status.md` and HANDOFF;
then only relevant source, claims and original evidence. Reconcile changed or
unavailable inputs. Produce a bounded implementation plan and separate facts,
arguments, hypotheses and recommendations. Do not implement or select an old
programme merely because it appears in a handoff.”

**Codex:** “Execute the named approved programme at its recorded revision.
Read the same four bootstrap files and the active milestone. Check local HEAD,
relevant working-tree differences and nested rules without touching protected
content. Preserve the selected scope, process handles, spent budget and prior
negatives. Complete the required implementation and evidence, or return a
precise blocking witness; do not substitute a new programme.”

The start message supplies the actual question or approved programme path/ref.
These snippets do not select work by themselves. Linked files are explicit reads,
not a claim that every client automatically loads arbitrary Markdown.

## Planning contract

Record available source/local evidence, question and decision, existing owners,
relevant premises/counterexamples and a compact Current/Finder/runtime applicability
matrix. Separate engineering deliverables from economic targets. State unchanged
problem identity, cohorts, total run allowance, conditional paths and stop rules.
Preserve the actual mathematical argument and where it belongs canonically.
For each new finding, retain its proposition, preconditions, evidence and
attempted falsification. Distinguish native facts, external theory, synthetic
calculations and hypotheses; identify what was actually run and cite sources.
A recommendation for the next programme is not execution authorization.

## During execution or interrupted continuation

Keep state in the programme's existing living record, not another status database:
last coherent commit and dirty paths; active milestone; completed and unrun checks;
actual process handles and ledger paths; spent and remaining run allowance; next
two concrete actions and gate; exact unresolved owner question, if any. Say whether
anything is still running. A context reset neither restarts a process nor grants
new experiments. HANDOFF contains a short pointer and operational summary.

## Intake and completion

Retain a useful original once. Inspect supplied scripts before executing them.
Reconcile its stated baseline with actual source, then classify material findings
as incorporated, duplicate, contradicted, scoped-negative, open, unavailable or
out of scope. A chat claim is not native measurement. Repetition is not independent
evidence. Put accepted reasoning in canonical mathematics and preserve immutable
receipts; do not close a broad claim merely to remove a lint warning.

The ordinary final reply is the receipt: actual implementation and per-lane
consumers; same-target economics versus semantic/profile contrasts; validation
and missing evidence; canonical links; local commit and real push status. Update
current status only to the reviewed scope. Record mandatory milestones replaced,
failed or unattempted separately. No additional receipt document or automatic push
is required. Sandbox paths and live chats are not durable repository references.
